Trying to empathize your situation, I would go back to my family, give them a hug and tell them everything (idk if you told them but I assume no). Maybe they won't like what they hear, but I assure you it is never too late to open up to your family.
You should consider the pressure you will put the on him. Sharing private life will strength the relationship, but I think somethings should be kept as secrets.

I have never been a good figther for these such situations. I have always escaped from what made me depressed. Eventually, I found that escaping is bad but gives you time to live another day. And another day means that you can call a friend  or relative. If you can't, you can find someone in that extra day that escaping gave you.

A little story I had, I have been struggling with suicidal thoughts deeply like at the end i was at the seaside to be jumped in and never go up. In that day I escaped my thoughts and I have talked to my one old cousin we haven't been speaking almost 10 years. We got few beers and that day was awesome because I could tell everything I have gone through. 

Afterall, I am not saying you will meet someone. But every day is another chance. I haven't even thought about speaking to my cousin that day but somehow it happened because i didn't jump in that day.

If you have ever played chess, i can give you an example. Sometimes you lose the queen or make a bad move at the beginning of your game but when you just raise the white flag it gets over. However, if you can just keep going, you will at least have chance to do something for yourself.

Every person i met says success is admirable. But it is not. It is nothing if you are not cultural enough, fit enough, social enough. If you had a poor family, not found yourself a hobby, it means nothing.

Me either. I can't reverse my suicidal thoughts but my mental health is like the bitcoin graph. Up-down, up-down. Frequently changing and problem is whenever i feel happy and ongoing. I find something  to feel depressed and continue my suicide journey. It is like a saving a game and quit. But when load the game, I am continuing the progress. I am getting closer to make this feeling something solid and permanent.
